units.source_text: 古歌：“殷勤陈祈愿，但愿洽私衷：

en.t: An old poem says, "With all my heart I set forth my prayer, wishing only that my private longing may be fulfilled:

units.source_text: 一似初濑杉，久别喜相逢。”

en.t: like the cedars of Hatsuse, after long separation, I rejoice to meet again."
This is found in the Kokin Wakashu Rokujō.
